info.title: Group 26 - Product Recommendation API
info.description: Interactive API Documentation and OpenAPI Specification for Group 26's Product Recommendation Web Application. Features activity tracking (views and favourites), deterministic activity-based recommendation engine, and user authentication.

servers.description: Auto-detect Server (Current host: production or localhost)

tags.name: Activities
tags.description: Task B6: Product view logging and user activity history APIs.

tags.name: Favourites
tags.description: Task B6: Product favourites management and dual-persistence tracking.

tags.name: Recommendations
tags.description: Task B7: Rule-based recommendation engine powered by weighted user engagement.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: User registration, login, logout, and account profile management.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Task B5: Product catalog browsing, full-text search, category filtering, and administrative management.

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: Task B5: Product taxonomy categories, category retrieval, and administrative management.

get.description: Returns the operational status of the Group 26 Express API server.

post.description: Creates a new user account with hashed password and default role 'User'.

example.message: Name, email and password are required

post.description: Authenticates user credentials and issues an HTTP-only JWT `accessToken` cookie. Subsequent requests from Swagger UI in the browser will automatically include this cookie.

get.description: Retrieves profile details. Allowed for the account owner or an Administrator.

403.description: Forbidden - Not authorized to view this user

put.description: Updates a user's name, email, and role. Requires Administrator privileges.

400.description: Name, email and role are required

delete.description: Permanently deletes a user from the system. Requires Administrator role.

post.description: Task B6: Records a `VIEW` interaction for a product by the authenticated user. Validates product existence before logging. Repeated views accumulate distinct timestamps, signaling stronger category interest to the recommendation engine.

400.description: Product ID is missing or invalid

get.description: Task B6: Fetches historical views and favourites for the authenticated user. Enforces strict user isolation. Enriches each record with product name, product image, and category ID.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of activity records to return.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Optional filter by activity type ('VIEW' or 'FAVOURITE').

post.description: Task B6: Adds a product to the user's favourites list. Validates product existence and rejects duplicate saves with HTTP 409 Conflict. Automatically logs a `FAVOURITE` event in the `activities` table for recommendation weighting (3x multiplier).

example.message: Product is already in your favourites

get.description: Task B6: Retrieves the authenticated user's favourited products, enriched with complete product information (name, description, price, image URL, stock, category name) and the `favourited_at` timestamp.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional maximum number of favourites to return.

data.name: Apple MacBook Pro 14 Inch
data.description: M3 Pro chip, 18GB Unified Memory, 512GB SSD Storage.

delete.description: Task B6: Deletes a product from the user's favourites. Validates user ownership so users cannot delete other users' favourites. Preserves historical entries in the `activities` table so recommendation signals remain intact.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: UUID of the product to unfavourite

404.description: Favourite record not found or not owned by user

get.description: Task B7: Returns activity-based product recommendations. Analyzes category affinity scores (views weighted 1x, favourites weighted 3x, repeated activity accumulated). Strictly excludes previously viewed and favourited products. Provides cold-start discovery items for new users and unauthenticated guests.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of recommendations to return (default: 8, max: 20).

data.name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones
data.description: Industry Leading noise canceling with Auto NC Optimizer.
data.recommendation_reason: Based on your interest in Electronics

get.description: Task B5: Retrieves all products in the catalog enriched with category details.

data.name: Apple iPhone 15 Pro
data.description: Titanium design with A17 Pro chip.

post.description: Task B5: Adds a new product to the catalog. Validates foreign key category existence. Requires Administrator role.

400.description: Validation error (missing required fields or category does not exist)

get.description: Task B5: Retrieves all product categories ordered alphabetically by name.

post.description: Task B5: Creates a new product category. Requires Administrator privileges.

get.description: Task B5: Retrieves details of a specific category by its UUID.

put.description: Task B5: Updates an existing category's name and description. Requires Administrator role.

delete.description: Task B5: Deletes a category. Requires Administrator role.

get.description: Task B5: Performs case-insensitive matching across product names and descriptions.
Task B5: Retrieves all products that belong to the specified category ID.
Task B5: Retrieves single product details by product UUID.

put.description: Task B5: Updates an existing product catalog entry. Requires Administrator role.

delete.description: Task B5: Deletes a product from the catalog. Requires Administrator role.

patch.description: Updates user account password. Allowed for account owner or an Administrator.

403.description: Forbidden - Unauthorized to change this password

cookieAuth.name: accessToken
cookieAuth.description: HTTP-only cookie containing the JWT access token. Authenticate by executing `POST /users/login` directly in Swagger UI.

bearerAuth.description: JWT Bearer token header (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). Supported for recommendation and external API testing.
